# Repository instructions

Keep this repository small, safe, and portable.

- Never add credentials, tokens, session data, personal paths, SSH settings,
  proxy configuration, MCP credentials, or private infrastructure details.
- Keep installers limited to the Copilot configuration directory.
- Preserve existing user configuration by skipping or backing up files before
  replacement.
- Do not pin a model, disable sandboxing, or enable broad permissions.
- Use only built-in shell and PowerShell features unless a dependency is
  documented in `README.md`.
- Validate the exact installation behavior changed by an edit.
